<title level="1" right="Focus 4" pfs="Standard">
[Repel Metal](/Spells.aspx?ID=1381)
<actions string="Reaction" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Druid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=52" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Metal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=505" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 145

**Domain**
[Metal](/Domains.aspx?ID=62)

<row gap="medium">

 

**Trigger** A Strike with a metallic weapon or projectile would hit you or an ally within range

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 60 feet

**Target** the creature targeted by the triggering Strike 
</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

You call forth a repelling field. The target gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack then misses, you direct the Strike back at the attacker, who compares the attack roll to their own AC. The target then becomes immune to this spell for 10 minutes.
name: Repel Metal
